I'm CodeBot 🤖, an advanced rule-based NLP chatbot built with Python.
My name is CodeBot. I use predefined rules, intent detection, fuzzy matching, entity extraction, and conversation memory.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the field of computer science focused on creating systems that can perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence.
AI enables computers to perform tasks such as understanding language, recognizing images, making predictions, and solving problems.
Machine Learning is a branch of AI where systems learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
Machine Learning allows computers to learn from examples and improve their performance without being explicitly programmed for every situation.
Python is a high-level programming language widely used in AI, machine learning, automation, web development, and data science.
Python is popular because of its readable syntax, large ecosystem, and extensive libraries.
Programming is the process of writing instructions that tell a computer how to perform a task.
Coding involves writing instructions in programming languages so that computers can solve problems and perform operations.
I normalize your text, compare it with predefined intent patterns, calculate confidence scores, extract entities, use conversation memory, and select an appropriate response.
I use rule-based NLP techniques rather than a large language model. My intent engine combines phrase matching, token overlap, and fuzzy matching.
I can detect intents, extract names and technologies, remember conversation context, answer basic AI and programming questions, calculate confidence scores, log conversations, and provide statistics.
